display.text:
# APK Launcher

Нативный (без WebView и HTML) Android-лаунчер: список установленных приложений, запуск одной кнопкой и **keep-alive**: выбранные приложения держатся живыми foreground-сервисом, который перезапускает процесс, если он умирает. ## Возможности - Полностью нативный UI `MainActivity`: поиск, сетка карточек с иконками и версиями, запуск по тапу. - Тумблер keep-alive на каждой карточке и в списке процессов. Держимые приложения не выскакивают поверх лаунчера: пока лаунчер на экране с фокусом, авто-подъём не срабатывает, а приложение, которое вы закрыли, не «воскрешается» мгновенно (кулдаун и авто-отказ после повторных закрытий). - Панель живых процессов с keep/запустить прямо из списка. - Foreground-сервис с частичным wake lock и ватчдогом (проверка каждые 2 с). - **Мультиоконность**: кнопка «окно» на каждой карточке/процессе открывает приложение в соседнем окне (split-screen); лаунчер при этом остаётся в другой половине экрана (`resumeWhilePausing`). - **Мини-окна для приложений**: тумблер «пин» сразу открывает приложение в интерактивном уменьшенном окне (весь UI, можно работать внутри — тап не разворачивает на весь экран) и держит его так же при авто-подъёме; «мини» — открыть любое приложение маленьким окном, «все мини» — все приложения на keep сразу каскадом в отдельных мини-окнах. - **Кнопки прямо поверх окна**: над каждым мини-приложением плавающий оверлей с кнопками — `▣` во весь экран, `+`/`−` увеличить/сузить, `◇` сменить позицию (углы/стороны/центр), `✕` открепить и скрыть. Управляется тапом, так что жесты можно вообще не использовать; требует разрешение «поверх других окон». - Панель обновлений: приложение сверяет версию с GitHub Releases и предлагает скачать APK новой версии. - Автономное обновление ключа версии: `versionName` берётся из последнего git-тега, `versionCode` строится из версии тега и коммитов после него. ## Структура - `android/` — весь код на Kotlin: нативный UI, `AppKeeper`, `KeepAliveService`, `Updater`. Веб-части нет. - `android/keystore.properties` и `android/keystore/` — локальные файлы для release-подписи; они не должны попадать в репозиторий. - `docs/` — обложка репозитория. ## Сборка ``` cd android ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug # debug (нужен SDK, адрес в local.properties) ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease # release; при наличии локального keystore.properties ``` Release получает версию из текущего git-тега. Для подписи нужно создать `android/keystore.properties` с параметрами локального keystore; файл и ключ исключены из репозитория. Без этих параметров сборка release останавливается с ошибкой, а не использует выдуманные значения. Если ключ раньше был опубликован, его нужно считать скомпрометированным и заменить новым. ## Как выкатить release ``` git tag v1.0.1 (cd android && ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease) apksigner verify --verbose android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk git push origin main --tags gh release create v1.0.1 android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk --title v1.0.1 ``` `Updater` проверяет именно опубликованный GitHub Release и показывает его, если в release есть APK-asset. Одного тега недостаточно. ## Что делает приложение - `MainActivity` — поиск, сетка карточек, тумблер keep/pin, панель процессов, мультиоконный и мини-оконный запуск, автообновление каждые 2.5 с, проверка обновлений при запуске. - `AppKeeper` — хранит списки «держимых» и «пинованных» пакетов в SharedPreferences и синхронизирует foreground-сервис. - `KeepAliveService` — ватчдог на wake lock: каждые 2 с проверяет `runningAppProcesses` и поднимает умерший процесс заново (пинованные — сразу в мини-окно); восстанавливает списки после перезапуска системой. - `Updater` — запрашивает `releases/latest` с GitHub, проверяет наличие APK и открывает ссылку на скачивание, если найдена более новая версия. ## Ограничения Android (workarounds) - Для списка launcher-приложений используется `` с `MAIN/LAUNCHER`; `QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES` не запрашивается. - На Android 10+ фоновый запуск приложений ограничен, поэтому обёртка использует foreground-сервис типа `specialUse` с удержанием wake lock. Автоматический перезапуск — best effort и зависит от разрешений и текущей политики Android. - На Android 10+ для автоматического перезапуска требуется разрешение `SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW`; без него Android может заблокировать запуск Activity. - На Android 13+ запрашивается разрешение `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`. - Мини-окна (`setLaunchBounds` + best-effort freeform-режим) раскрываются в интерактивные свободные окна на системах с поддержкой freeform (планшеты, десктоп-режим, Android 15+ с несколькими окнами); на обычных телефонах без freeform приложение открывается обычным запуском. Android не даёт сторонним приложениям уходить в системный PiP, поэтому именно freeform — единственный путь к «приложению в маленьком интерактивном окне».

        val packageName: String,
        val label: String,
        val versionName: String,
        val icon: Drawable?,
    )

    private data class ProcEntry(
        val packageName: String,
        val pid: Int,
        val importance: String,
    )

    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private val keeper by lazy { AppKeeper(applicationContext) }

    private var allApps: List<AppEntry> = emptyList()
    private var processes: List<ProcEntry> = emptyList()
    private var keptPkgs: Set<String> = emptySet()
    private var pinnedPkgs: Set<String> = emptySet()
    private var query = ""
    private var showKeptOnly = false
    private var lastSig = ""

    private lateinit var statAppsLabel: TextView
    private lateinit var statAliveNum: TextView
    private lateinit var statSplitNum: TextView
    private lateinit var scrollContent: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var cardsBox: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var processPanel: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var updateBar: LinearLayout

    private val refresh = object : Runnable {
        override fun run() {
            loadProcesses()
            render()
            handler.postDelayed(this, REFRESH_MS)
        }
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        buildUi()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        maybeRequestNotifPermission()
        loadApps()
        keptPkgs = keeper.list().toSet()
        pinnedPkgs = keeper.pinnedList().toSet()
        keeper.syncService()
        showPendingOverlays()
        loadProcesses()
        lastSig = ""
        render()
        handler.removeCallbacks(refresh)
        handler.post(refresh)
        checkForUpdate()
    }

    override fun onPause() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(refresh)
        super.onPause()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(refresh)
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    private fun maybeRequestNotifPermission() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU &&

    private fun openUrl(url: String) {
        val uri = runCatching { Uri.parse(url) }.getOrNull()
        if (uri == null || uri.scheme != "https" || !isTrustedUpdateHost(uri.host)) {
            toast("Некорректная ссылка обновления")
            return
        }
        runCatching {
            startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, uri))
        }.onFailure { toast("Не удалось открыть ссылку") }
    }

    private fun isTrustedUpdateHost(host: String?): Boolean {
        val value = host?.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) ?: return false
        return value == "github.com" ||
            value == "githubusercontent.com" ||
            value.endsWith(".github.com") ||
            value.endsWith(".githubusercontent.com")
    }

        }
        val cols = maxOf(1, resources.configuration.screenWidthDp / MIN_CARD_WIDTH_DP)
        var i = 0
        while (i < filtered.size) {
            val row = hBox()
            row.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
            for (c in 0 until cols) {
                val cell = vBox()
                cell.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
                cell.setPadding(dp(4), dp(6), dp(4), dp(6))
                if (i + c < filtered.size) cell.addView(buildCard(filtered[i + c]))
                row.addView(cell)
            }
            cardsBox.addView(row)
            i += cols
        }
    }

    private fun toggleKeep(pkg: String) {
        val keep = pkg !in keptPkgs
        if (keep && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q && !hasOverlayPermission()) {
            toast("Для автоперезапуска включите отображение поверх других окон")
            requestOverlayPermission()
            return
        }
        if (!keeper.set(pkg, keep)) {
            toast("Не удалось изменить keep-alive")
            return
        }
        keptPkgs = if (keep) keptPkgs + pkg else keptPkgs - pkg
        if (!keep) {
            pinnedPkgs = pinnedPkgs - pkg
            overlayFor(pkg, show = false)
        }
        lastSig = ""
        renderCards()
        updateStats()
        updateProcessPane()
    }

    private fun launch(pkg: String) {

            val i = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(pkg) ?: return@runCatching false
            i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
            startActivity(i)
            true
        }.getOrDefault(false)

    }

    private fun launchAdjacent(pkg: String) {

            i.addFlags(
                Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or
                    Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_LAUNCH_ADJACENT
            )
            startActivity(i, ActivityOptions.makeBasic().toBundle())
            true
        }.getOrDefault(false)
        if (!ok) toast("Не удалось открыть $pkg рядом")
    }

    private fun launchMini(pkg: String) {
        launchMini(pkg, 0)
    }

    private fun launchMini(pkg: String, offset: Int) {
        val launch = runCatching {
            packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(pkg)
        }.getOrNull()
        if (launch == null) {
            toast("Не удалось найти приложение $pkg")
            return
        }
        launch.addFlags(
            Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or
                Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_MULTIPLE_TASK or
                Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_RETAIN_IN_RECENTS
        )
        val requestedOffset = if (offset == 0 && pkg !in miniBoundsByPackage) {
            miniBoundsByPackage.size * 2
        } else {
            offset
        }
        val bounds = miniBoundsByPackage[pkg] ?: miniWindowBounds(requestedOffset).also {
            miniBoundsByPackage[pkg] = Rect(it)
        }
        val launchedInWindow = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
            runCatching {
                val options = ActivityOptions.makeBasic().apply {
                    setLaunchBounds(bounds)
                    setFreeformModeBestEffort()
                }
                startActivity(launch, options.toBundle())
                true
            }.getOrDefault(false)
        } else {
            false
        }
        if (launchedInWindow) {
            showOverlayOrRequest(pkg, bounds)
            return
        }
        val opened = runCatching {
            startActivity(launch)
            true
        }.getOrDefault(false)
        if (opened) {
            toast("Свободное окно недоступно — открыто обычное окно")
        } else {
            toast("Не удалось открыть $pkg")
        }
    }

    private fun openKeptInMiniWindows() {
        val pkgs = keptPkgs.sorted()
        if (pkgs.isEmpty()) {
            toast("Нет приложений на keep")
            return
        }
        pkgs.forEachIndexed { idx, pkg -> launchMini(pkg, idx) }
    }

    private fun miniWindowBounds(offset: Int): Rect {
        val w = (screenWidth() * 0.62f).toInt()
        val h = (screenHeight() * 0.6f).toInt()
        val gap = dp(14)
        val maxX = (screenWidth() - w - gap).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val maxY = (screenHeight() - h - gap).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val step = dp(32)
        val maxSteps = minOf(maxX, maxY) / step
        val steps = offset.coerceIn(0, maxSteps)
        val x = (maxX - steps * step).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val y = (maxY - steps * step).coerceAtLeast(0)
        return Rect(x, y, x + w, y + h)
    }

    private fun ActivityOptions.setFreeformModeBestEffort() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            runCatching {
                ActivityOptions::class.java
                    .getMethod("setLaunchWindowingMode", Int::class.javaPrimitiveType)
                    .apply { isAccessible = true }
                    .invoke(this, WINDOWING_MODE_FREEFORM)
            }
        }
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
            runCatching {
                ActivityOptions::class.java
                    .getMethod("setLaunchStackId", Int::class.javaPrimitiveType)
                    .apply { isAccessible = true }
                    .invoke(this, FREEFORM_STACK_ID)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun togglePin(pkg: String) {
        val clean = pkg.substringBefore(':')
        val pin = clean !in pinnedPkgs
        if (!keeper.setPin(clean, pin)) {
            toast("Не удалось изменить мини-окно")
            return
        }
        pinnedPkgs = if (pin) pinnedPkgs + clean else pinnedPkgs - clean
        if (pin) keptPkgs = keptPkgs + clean
        lastSig = ""
        renderCards()
        if (pin) launchMini(clean) else overlayFor(clean, show = false)
    }

    private fun showOverlayOrRequest(pkg: String, bounds: Rect) {
        val clean = pkg.substringBefore(':')
        if (hasOverlayPermission()) {
            pendingOverlays.remove(clean)
            overlayFor(clean, show = true, bounds = bounds)
            return
        }
        pendingOverlays[clean] = Rect(bounds)
        requestOverlayPermission()
        toast("Включите «отображение поверх других окон» для кнопок мини-окна")
    }

    private fun requestOverlayPermission() {
        runCatching {
            startActivity(
                Intent(
                    Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION,
                    Uri.parse("package:$packageName"),
                )
            )
        }.onFailure {
            toast("Не удалось открыть настройки разрешения")
        }
    }

    private fun showPendingOverlays() {
        if (!hasOverlayPermission() || pendingOverlays.isEmpty()) return
        val pending = pendingOverlays.toMap()
        pendingOverlays.clear()
        pending.forEach { (pkg, bounds) -> overlayFor(pkg, show = true, bounds = bounds) }
    }

    private fun hasOverlayPermission(): Boolean =
        Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.M || Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)

    private fun overlayFor(pkg: String, show: Boolean, bounds: Rect? = null) {
        val clean = pkg.substringBefore(':')
        val i = Intent(this, KeepAliveService::class.java)
            .setAction(
                if (show) KeepAliveService.ACTION_SHOW_OVERLAY
                else KeepAliveService.ACTION_HIDE_OVERLAY
            )
            .putExtra(KeepAliveService.EXTRA_PKG, clean)
        if (bounds != null) i.putExtra(KeepAliveService.EXTRA_BOUNDS, bounds)
        runCatching {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                startForegroundService(i)
            } else {
                startService(i)
            }
        }.onFailure {
            toast("Не удалось запустить панель мини-окна")
        }
    }

    private fun loadApps() {
        val pm = packageManager
        val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER)
        val resolved = runCatching { pm.queryIntentActivities(intent, 0) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
        val seen = HashSet<String>()
        val apps = ArrayList<AppEntry>()
        for (ri in resolved) {
            val pkg = ri.activityInfo.packageName
            if (pkg == packageName) continue
            if (!seen.add(pkg)) continue
            val label = runCatching {
                pm.getApplicationLabel(pm.getApplicationInfo(pkg, 0)).toString()
            }.getOrDefault(pkg)
            val version = runCatching { pm.getPackageInfo(pkg, 0).versionName ?: "" }.getOrDefault("")
            val icon = runCatching { pm.getApplicationIcon(pkg) }.getOrNull()
            apps.add(AppEntry(pkg, label, version, icon))
        }
        apps.sortBy { it.label.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }
        allApps = apps
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun loadProcesses() {
        val am = getSystemService(ACTIVITY_SERVICE) as android.app.ActivityManager
        val running = am.runningAppProcesses ?: emptyList()
        val list = ArrayList<ProcEntry>()
        for (p in running) {
            if (p.importance <= 0 ||
                p.importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_EMPTY
            ) {
                continue
            }
            list.add(ProcEntry(p.processName, p.pid, importanceName(p.importance)))
        }
        processes = list
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun importanceName(importance: Int): String = when {
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_GONE -> "gone"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_EMPTY -> "empty"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_BACKGROUND -> "background"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_TOP_SLEEPING -> "sleeping"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_SERVICE -> "service"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_PERCEPTIBLE -> "perceptible"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_VISIBLE -> "visible"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_FOREGROUND_SERVICE -> "сервис"
        importance >= android.app.ActivityManager.RunningAppProcessInfo.IMPORTANCE_FOREGROUND -> "foreground"
        else -> "unknown"
    }

**KeepAliveService (the biggest drain — runs 24/7 in foreground with a PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK held forever):**

1. `wakeLock.acquire()` with no timeout — held permanently. `@SuppressLint("WakelockTimeout")`. This prevents the CPU from ever sleeping. The watchdog runs every 2s on the main looper, and re-acquires each time. Since the callback is posted with `postDelayed(2s)`, the CPU must wake up every 2 seconds anyway. The wake lock is held permanently which means the device never enters deep idle.

   Key fix: acquire the wake lock only around the actual check work (a short window), release after. But then postDelayed would not fire while CPU asleep... Actually with a foreground service, the CPU does get to sleep between wakeful work; the handler postDelayed will fire when other things wake the CPU, but might be delayed. The standard pattern: acquire wakelock, do work, release, and post delayed. Android batches these. Holding a permanent wakelock means the SoC never idles → measurable drain.

   Best approach: use a `WakefulBroadcastReceiver`-ish pattern, or simply acquire the lock for the duration of the check and release it. Also reduce the interval and add adaptive backoff.

2. The 2-second polling interval is aggressive. Adaptive: fast poll when something needs attention (a kept process recently died / needs relaunch, or overlay needs showing), slow poll (e.g. 10-15s) when everything is stable. Relaunch min gap is 15s so a 15s poll still meets the SLA reasonably... Actually the requirement: after a process dies, relaunch within reasonable time. If we back off to, say, 10s when idle, worst case relaunch delay becomes 10s instead of 2s. That's a behavior tradeoff. Hmm. Better: keep responsive detection but avoid burning CPU. 

   A smarter approach: use `ActivityManager` callbacks? There's no public "process died" listener. But we can use `UsageStatsManager` or `PackageManager` broadcast... Actually a much cheaper signal: instead of polling runningAppProcesses, we can register a `BroadcastReceiver` for... hmm, there's no ACTION for process death publicly.

   A real, well-known low-power approach: `ActivityManager.getRunningAppProcesses()` is a cheap binder call actually. The expensive parts are:
   - `am.getRunningTasks(1)` — this is much more expensive than getRunningAppProcesses and it's called every 2 s. It does a full task-list query (100+ tasks). This is the real hot spot.
   - The main-thread handler.

   Optimization: only query `getRunningTasks(1)` when needed (i.e., when at least one kept process is dead and we might relaunch), not on every tick. Use the cheap fallback (importance == FOREGROUND check from runningAppProcesses we already have).

3. `current.any { isProcessForPackage(it, pkg) }` inside a loop over active packages — O(N*M) but N and M are small. Not a real problem but easy to make O(1) with a precomputed set of process names. With 2s polling, tiny. But `for (pkg in overlays.keys.toList()) current.none {...}` also. Minor.

4. `saveState()` writes SharedPreferences every 30s — `apply()` writes to disk asynchronously. It writes ~5 keys per package. Every 30s is a disk write. Could be increased and made conditional (only write when dirty).

5. `activePackages()` allocates a new set via `(kept + pinned).toSet()` — called multiple times per tick (line 91, 136, 176, 126). Each allocation. Trivial but easy to cache.

6. The notification is rebuilt on every onStartCommand — fine.

7. Bigger idea: **Don't hold a permanent wakelock at all.** Use a short wake lock around the watchdog work. Also add `setForegroundServiceBehavior`? Not needed.

8. **Screen-off / idle handling**: when the screen is off and nothing is happening, back off heavily. Use `PowerManager.isInteractive` to check if the device is awake. If the screen is off, kept processes mostly stay alive; polling can go to 30-60s. But relaunch intent while screen off is a matter of taste. I'd make the backoff depend on "everything stable" and screen state.

Too slow.

   - acquire wakelock only for the tick duration (with timeout guard)
   - adaptive interval: 2s when unstable/at risk, up to 10-15s when stable, up to 30-60s when screen off and stable

   - avoid SharedPreferences writes unless state changed

**MainActivity:**
1. `refresh` every 2.5s while visible: calls `loadProcesses()` (runningAppProcesses — a binder call, moderate), then `render()` → `updateStats()` and `updateProcessPane()`.
2. `updateProcessPane()` calls `processPanel.removeAllViews()` and rebuilds ALL process rows EVERY 2.5 s, and each row calls `packageManager.getApplicationIcon(base)` — that's a resource load per row per 2.5s! This is a huge battery/CPU cost. With 50 processes → 50 icon loads every 2.5 seconds. Definitely the biggest UI-side drain.
3. `renderCards()` calls `cardsBox.removeAllViews()` and rebuilds every card when sig changes; sig changes whenever any app's alive state changes, which is often. Each card holds a 52dp icon drawable (already loaded, so no re-fetch, but re-inflation of the whole grid each time).
4. `updateStats()` uses `String.format` with Locale — allocates, minor.
5. The updater check on every onResume — network request each time. Should throttle (e.g., once per 6 h).
6. `sig()` builds a big string every 2.5 s — for 200 apps that's ~2-4KB string; minor but wasteful.

- Cache icons in a map (packageName -> Drawable) so `getApplicationIcon` is called once per package.
- Only rebuild the process pane when its content signature actually changed (pid/importance/kept/pinned). Currently it always rebuilds.
- Stop the 2.5s refresh when the activity isn't visible — already done in onPause. But also: when the window loses focus? onPause covers it.
- Throttle the updater network check.
- Increase refresh interval when nothing changes / when the process list is stable: adaptive backoff (2.5s → 10s) is a solid win.

Also the big one: `loadApps()` on every onResume — loads ALL app icons via `getApplicationIcon` (expensive: resource loading + bitmap decode for ~200 apps). This happens on every resume. Should cache in memory across resumes (a singleton cache) and only reload when the package list changed (detect via a cheap check). And use `icon` loading lazily.

- `pruneMissingPackages()` is called on EVERY `list()`, `isKept()`, `pinnedList()`, `isPinned()` call, and it does `isInstalled()` for each stored key — each `isInstalled` does `getApplicationInfo` (binder) and possibly `getLaunchIntentForPackage` and even `runningAppProcesses`. Should cache pruning with a timestamp (e.g. prune at most once per 30s) and short-circuit when prefs are empty.
- Also `AppKeeper` is constructed fresh in `MainActivity.toggleKeep` (`AppKeeper(this).set(...)`) and in the service — each construction runs `pruneMissingPackages`. Add a shared singleton instance in the Application? There's no Application class. Simplest: make pruning lazy/time-throttled inside the instance + a companion-level cache keyed by prefs. Let me keep it simple: add a `pruneAt` timestamp in a companion object (process-wide) so at most one prune per 60s, and skip entirely if both prefs are empty.

Key optimizations:

### KeepAliveService (biggest drain, 24/7)
1. **Wake lock**: acquire only for the duration of a tick with a timeout, release right after. Currently held forever → CPU never idles.
2. **Adaptive polling**: 
   - base 2s when "active" (something needs action: a process is dead and pending relaunch, overlay is missing but pinned, or recently changed state)
   - back off to 5s when stable
   - back off to 15s (or 30s when screen off) when everything is stable
   - immediately drop to fast when the screen turns on / a relaunch is due (listen to ACTION_SCREEN_ON? Registering a receiver in a service for screen on is a good "wake up fast" signal. That is cheap: a manifest-less runtime receiver in onCreate. But ACTION_SCREEN_ON requires the receiver to be registered; it's allowed. Let me add it — register in onCreate, unregister in onDestroy.)
3. **Don't call getRunningTasks every tick** — only when a relaunch decision is actually pending (a kept process is dead and past the cooldown). Fall back to the cheap importance check otherwise.
4. **Precompute a process-name → running set** once per tick instead of O(N*M) scans.
5. **saveState() only when dirty** and on state transitions; drop the unconditional 30s write.
6. **Cache activePackages()** per tick instead of allocating 3x.
7. **Notification**: only rebuild/update when the text changes.

Careful about behavior preservation: relaunch timing. With adaptive backoff, worst case detection delay grows. To preserve responsiveness, use the "pending relaunch" fast path: if a kept process was alive on the previous tick and is now dead, we're at the "just died" stage. The relaunch requires `now - lastAliveAt >= RELAUNCH_MIN_GAP_MS` (15s) which means we must NOT relaunch immediately anyway — the cooldown is 15 s. So polling at 5s instead of 2s barely changes the relaunch timing (granularity goes from 2s to 5s on a 15s cooldown). That's a very safe tradeoff. I'll use: FAST 2s while unstable/at-risk, NORMAL 5s stable, IDLE 15s stable + screen off.

Hmm, but also the overlay show for pinned: `if (pkg in pinned && !overlays.containsKey(pkg)) showOverlay(pkg)` — happens on any alive tick. Backoff to 5s means the overlay appears up to 5s later. Acceptable. Actually, better: we can show the overlay right at relaunch time (relaunch already calls showOverlay for pinned). So overlay latency is mostly covered.

To be safe, I'll make the "hot" conditions explicit:
- any kept package currently dead (not alive) → FAST
- overlays exist and screen is on → NORMAL (they need positioning/verification)
- all alive, screen off → IDLE (15s)
- all alive, screen on → NORMAL (5s)

That's a solid design. And I keep WATCH_INTERVAL_MS = 2000 as the fast interval, so worst case behavior is identical to today in the hot state.
